# Potential Infinite Loop in Merged PR Listing

In the merged PR listing, while pagination is capped at 10 pages, if the API returns unexpected results or if token permissions limit access, there could be unhandled scenarios leading to excessive requests.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/collectors/forge.py` — `knowledge_compiler.collectors.forge.GitHubGateway.list_merged_prs`
